title: Personal OKR Milestone Burn-Up
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:okr objective_name=* milestone_points=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(milestone_points) as metric by _time objective_name
| sort 0 _time objective_name
description: Trends monthly milestone points by objective for OKR progress.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether OKR progress are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `objective_name` on `lifeos:okr` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly milestone points.
visualization: Line chart of monthly milestone points by objective.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how milestone points changes month by month for each objective so you can see whether OKR progress are heading the right way.
